class.name: end_effector_hardware/EndEffectorHardware
class.description: One end effector on a robot_comm bus (parameter bus: usb_rs485://..., arm_rs485://...), chosen by the parameter device: jodell_rg75, linkerhand_l6, xhand1.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/Kwr75Sensor
class.description: KWR75 six-axis force / torque sensor on a robot_comm bus (parameter bus: usb_rs485://..., arm_rs485://...), polled once per read() without waiting.

class.name: end_effector_hardware/LinkerHandCanHardware
class.description: LinkerHand dexterous hand on classic CAN (1 Mbit/s), one hand per system; hand_type selects the model (linkerhand_l6). Left hand ID 0x28, right 0x27. Position feedback at 50 Hz, optional tactile.
